decision: Selected the centroid of the union of the two adjoining Dallas Central Appraisal District parcels held by Edged entities in Irving, 320251000A0020000 (Edged Dallas LLC, situs 505 N Wildwood Dr) and 320251000A01R0000 (Edged Dallas 2 LLC, situs 300 N Walton Walker Blvd), as the campus locator for Edged's Irving (DFW01) campus. TDLR places the Edged DFW Data Center registrations at 505 N Wildwood Dr and the DFW1-2 new building at 501 N Wildwood Dr; Edged's Dallas page describes an Irving campus with two facilities (DFW01-1 and DFW01-2) at 300 North Loop 12, and the TxGIO address point for 300 N Walton Walker Blvd and the selected centroid both fall inside parcel 320251000A01R0000. The point represents the two-parcel campus, not the converted building where the Interior Fit-Out 2 takes place or the DFW1-2 building, neither of which has a published footprint.

identity_bridge: TDLR TABS2027004847 (registered 2026-10-30): 'DFW Data Center Interior Fit-Out 2', facility 'Edged - DFW Data Center', 505 N. Wildwood Dr, Irving 75061, Dallas County; owner Edged Dallas LLC, 30 Old Kings Hwy S Ste 1005, Darien, Connecticut.

TDLR TABS2023026611 (2023-08-23): 'Edged DFW Data Center', conversion of an existing warehouse at 505 N Wildwood Drive to data processing halls; TABS2026018130 (2026-04-20): 'Edged Dallas', facility 'DFW1-2', new two-storey data center at 501 N. Wildwood Dr; both owned by Edged Dallas LLC.

Dallas Central Appraisal District data in the TxGIO parcel layer (tax year 2026): 320251000A0020000, owner Edged Dallas LLC, mailed to 30 Old Kings Hwy S Ste 1005, Darien CT, situs 505 N Wildwood Dr, Irving, 11.326 legal acres; 320251000A01R0000, owner Edged Dallas 2 LLC, mailed to 30 Old Kings Hwy S PMB 1005, Darien CT, situs 300 N Walton Walker Blvd, Irving, 15.808 legal acres.

Edged's Dallas page (edged.us/dallas, captured 2026-11-06) lists 'Irving | DFW01-1 & DFW01-2 | 48 MW | Campus with two facilities | 300 North Loop 12, Irving, TX 75061 | 15-acre campus'. Walton Walker Boulevard carries Loop 12 through Irving; the TxGIO 300 N WALTON WALKER BLVD point lies inside 320251000A01R0000. The page's map widget was not read.
alternatives_rejected: Centroid of parcel 320251000A0020000 (505 N Wildwood Dr) alone: it locates the converted-warehouse lot named in the fit-out registration but not the operator-stated campus address or the DFW1-2 building lot; it lies 98.7 m from the selected point and is recorded as context.
TxGIO address point for 505 N Wildwood Dr: none exists in the address-point layer; the nearest Wildwood point, 510 N Wildwood Dr, is across the street and outside both parcels.
The 300 N Walton Walker Blvd address point alone: an address reference near the Loop 12 frontage, used only as an identity check.

Edged's 15-acre figure: the two parcels total 27.1 geodesic acres; the operator figure is not reconciled. The union is kept because the operator describes one Irving campus with two facilities at an address inside 320251000A01R0000, while the fit-out building's registered address is the situs of 320251000A0020000; the DFW1-2 registration at 501 N Wildwood Dr has no address point or parcel situs and is not matched to either parcel.
Census or commercial geocoders, operator map widgets, OpenStreetMap, Nominatim and Overpass: not used.
